name: Actions
tagline: Workflow runs, job graph, logs and re-runs
summary: GitHub Actions for a repository: a filterable list of workflow runs, a run page with a job graph, step logs, artifacts and re-run buttons, and a job page with full logs.

flow.label: Actions list route
flow.note: Sends status, event, actor and branch filters to the API and lists 30 runs per page.

flow.label: getWorkflowRunsForRepo
flow.note: Lists workflow runs for the repo from GitHub REST.

flow.label: WorkflowRunPage
flow.note: Reads the run, jobs, artifacts and workflow definition, then shows summary, graph and artifacts.

flow.label: Adaptive polling
flow.note: Refetches every 10 s while running, 30 s otherwise, and stops 10 minutes after the data settles.

flow.label: Job graph canvas
flow.note: Places jobs in dependency columns, folds matrix jobs into one node, opens step logs as nodes.

flow.label: getWorkflowRunLogsBundle
flow.note: Downloads a finished run's log zip, unzips it with fflate and returns text per job step.

features.name: Run list
features.summary: Runs with status, event, actor and branch filters sent to GitHub, plus search and sorting over the loaded page.

features.name: Job graph
features.summary: Jobs drawn as a graph from the workflow file's needs; a matrix job is one node that fans out to its variants.

entry.role: Matches YAML jobs to run jobs, lays out
Reads and parses the workflow YAML

features.name: Step logs in the graph
features.summary: Opening a step shows its log as its own node on the canvas, cut out of the job log by group name or time range; live jobs refresh every 4 s.

entry.role: Cuts one step out of a job log
Log lines with groups and levels

features.name: Job page
features.summary: Every step of one job with collapsible log groups, error and warning rows, durations and a sidebar listing the run's jobs.

entry.role: Live job log, app token then user token

features.name: Re-run jobs
features.summary: Re-run all jobs or only the failed ones. The buttons appear only when the viewer has push or admin rights on the repo.

entry.role: Run title, links and re-run menu

features.name: Run artifacts
features.summary: Lists a run's artifacts with size, digest and expiry. Downloads link to GitHub's archive URL.

entry.role: Server read: artifacts of a run

features.name: Check state icons
features.summary: One mapping from status and conclusion to an icon and colour, shared by runs, jobs, steps and the pull request checks list.

entry.role: Status and conclusion to one state

entryPoints.role: Run list and how filters map to the API
Run page: queries, polling and layout
Graph state: collapsed nodes, open logs, layout
Job page and its two log sources
All Actions server functions live in this file
Query options with the polling rules

goodParts: Polling is centralised: lib/github-refetch-policy.ts states the rate-limit cost behind each interval and is covered by github-refetch-policy.test.ts.
The canvas is lazy-loaded behind a frame-shaped skeleton (workflow-run-graph.tsx), so @xyflow/react stays out of other pages' code.
watch: No tests under components/workflows: graph/parse-step-log.ts (227 lines) and graph/build-layout.ts (142 lines) are pure logic, and no e2e spec opens an Actions page.
getWorkflowJobLogs and the logs bundle print console.log lines on every call (lib/github/actions.ts:482, 496, 519, 715).
lib/github/actions.ts is 771 lines; open step logs poll every 4 s on a fixed interval, outside the adaptive policy (graph/step-log-node.tsx:50).
